body:
Looks good to me, tested on macOS with a mouse, keyboard and game controller.

--------

```gdscript
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	print("++++++++++++++++++++")
	print("_input:", event)
	print("device:", event.device)
	print("--------------------")
```
